sourceNotes: AI 小组件新增累计 Token 展示，支持输入、输出与今日用量
订阅额度小组件固定显示四个圆环，按剩余额度着色，并区分未知、过期和上次数据
全局快捷键按窗口与导航、系统控制、计时与休息分组，辅助工具不可用提示不再重复显示
主程序的临时签名或未签名开发构建可通过在线更新安装正式版，仍校验更新清单与安装包签名
修复小组件共享数据不可读时误报功能未启用的问题，日历继续保留公历日期
修复连续切换音频输出、取消操作和调整静音设备音量时的音量、静音与路由恢复问题
修复风扇控制与合盖运行在锁屏、休眠及恢复期间的保护与状态恢复问题，并补齐传感器连接失败后的重试
修复启动项启停与卸载预览的配置复核问题
修复暂停和退出时历史记录的累计与写入顺序、出口检测取消后的过期结果，以及部分网络响应解析问题
修复截图保存期间仍可通过键盘修改或删除标注的问题

en: Add a cumulative Token widget with input, output, and today’s usage. Local statistics cover the last 365 days; Magpie shows all of its recorded history.
Show four fixed subscription quota rings, color them by remaining quota, and distinguish unknown, expired, and last successful readings.
Group global shortcuts into Windows & Navigation, System Controls, and Timers & Breaks, and remove duplicate helper-unavailable messages.
Allow ad-hoc and unsigned development builds of the main app to install official releases through online updates, while retaining update-feed and archive signature verification.
Fix widgets incorrectly reporting disabled features when shared data is unreadable; calendar widgets retain the Gregorian date.
Fix volume, mute, and routing restoration during repeated audio-output switches, cancellation, and volume changes on muted devices.
Fix fan-control and closed-lid protection and recovery around locking, sleep, and wake, and retry failed sensor connections.
Revalidate startup-item configurations and uninstall previews to avoid operating on changed items or selecting data owned by independently installed apps, and clarify Homebrew quit messages.
Fix history accumulation and write ordering on pause and quit, stale results after canceling egress checks, and parsing of some network responses.
Prevent keyboard shortcuts from modifying or deleting annotations while a screenshot is being saved.
